convertibility_reason: Uses custom signal filter CBH_BH_RSI from external .mqh library (Expert\Signal\MySignals\ACBH_BH_RSI.mqh). Entry/exit logic is encapsulated in this custom class, requiring manual extraction of trading rules from the library before Python conversion is possible.

indicators.name: MA on RSI for BH filter

other_exits: Signal-based close when CBH_BH_RSI signal strength drops below Signal_ThresholdClose (20), with pending order expiration after 4 bars

custom_logic_notes: Trading logic is entirely encapsulated in CBH_BH_RSI class from ACBH_BH_RSI.mqh. The signal uses a weighted voting system (Weight=1.0) with configurable open threshold (40) and close threshold (20). Pending orders have a 4-bar expiration. The EA uses CExpertSignal's threshold-based system where filter votes are weighted and summed against threshold values. Expert_EveryTick=false means processing happens once per bar, not every tick. The BH (Barishpolcy) RSI strategy likely compares RSI to its MA and generates buy/sell based on crosses, but exact logic requires reading the .mqh file.
python_conversion_notes: Must extract CBH_BH_RSI::LongCondition() and ShortCondition() methods from ACBH_BH_RSI.mqh to determine exact entry/exit logic. The threshold-based signal system (open>=40, close>=20) needs to be translated to direct boolean conditions in Python. The CExpert framework handles position management, trailing, and money management - these are standard and can be reimplemented. No SL/TP is set (both=0), so exits are purely signal-driven. Pending order expiration of 4 bars needs a bar-counting mechanism in Python.
